The Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) is planning to launch the Cockroach Club, a physical space for young people to exchange ideas, engage in discussions and explore different perspectives. Spokesperson and co-convenor Saurav Das has outlined plans for lectures, film screenings, cultural events, stand-up comedy and dedicated reading and study spaces. Here's what the proposed club aims to offer.
